stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[3].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

composite_key.statement: Rows are duplicates when all key columns (one or more) match exactly; differing in any key column keeps them distinct.

keep_first.statement: keep-first retains the first row per key in original order.

keep_last.statement: keep-last retains the last row per key, ordered by position of that last row.

output_csv.statement: The result is written to the output CSV path with the original header.

error_strategy.statement: With the error strategy and duplicates present the CLI exits 1, lists the duplicated keys on stderr and writes no output file; without duplicates it exits 0.

summary.statement: Stdout contains the number of duplicates found and the number removed.
must_include: summary of duplicates found and removed

bad_input.statement: A missing key column or unreadable input file exits 2 with a message on stderr.

single_file_stdlib.statement: data_dedup.py imports only standard library modules and runs standalone.
